name: Linux runtime (gamescope + native ARM Steam)
note: Arch Linux ARM aarch64 rootfs with gamescope 3.16, Xwayland, Mesa 26.2 (Turnip with the KGSL backend, Zink), GTK 2, PulseAudio and Bannerlator's session scripts. Installed by the app into files/linuxfs; a gamescope session refuses to start without it. r5 replaces r4, whose proot starts a session and then aborts on the first icon a GTK client loads; r5 carries the build that holds. The runtime brings proot with it at opt/android-host, so it installs and runs without root and an app update cannot replace it, and every installed title is set to the ARM64 Proton automatically - listed as Bannerlator Proton (ARM64) so it is not mistaken for Valve's own ARM64 Protons, which need user namespaces Android does not give. Contains no Valve software - the native arm64 Steam client is fetched from Valve at first use. Built from tools/linuxfs in the Bannerlator repo; ported from WinNative's gamescope runtime (GPL-3.0).
